summary: Extended hard-deny substitution parsing to extract unquoted bash process substitutions (<(...) and >(...)) and recurse into their contents, while preserving quote-context behavior so single- and double-quoted process-substitution text is ignored. Added tests for unquoted detection (including nested shell command content), dual-stream process substitution coverage, and quote exclusion. Verification passed: pnpm vitest run src/goal/hard-deny.test.ts, pnpm build, pnpm vitest run src/goal/, pnpm lint, and node scripts/run-node.mjs goal --help.
